name: growing-outside-in-systems
description: Drive feature development using Outside-In TDD with Hexagonal Architecture. Design emerges through inline code, in-memory fakes, interface extraction, and deferred I/O. Use when building features, writing tests, or structuring backend services. Triggers on: TDD, outside-in, hexagonal, ports and adapters, emergent design, acceptance test, component test, walking skeleton, in-memory fakes, component, contract test, adapter, fast tests, sub-second feedback. Language-agnostic (Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Java, C#).
